/* Operand-only repair: the original C7 /0 stores write two guest DWORD
 * immediates, not native symbol addresses. Hidden EAX/EDX inputs, guest memory
 * and the existing x87 mismatch remain ABI_UNVERIFIED: the integer copy below
 * is not equivalent to the original FLD/FSTP for all inputs. No whole-function
 * semantic, original-machine or byte-match claim. */

limitations: Only two RHS operands and one boundary comment change; types, signature, declarations, hidden registers and all other operations remain unchanged.
The existing integer copy is not equivalent to the original FLD/FSTP for all inputs. x87 exceptions, conversion, register state and whole-function behavior remain unverified.
An initialized uint32_t isolated-store fixture checks values, offsets, widths and neighboring words; it executes neither original code nor the canonical function.
Complete private body/hash/boundary/flow consistency does not reauthenticate the complete original XBE or prove game ABI, mapping, behavior or byte match.
